method: The search-v3 stack is untracked on this branch, so git cannot isolate the diff; changes were audited by inspection against the known Phase 10 edit set.

changes.change: FILENAME_LITERAL channel also probes the whole query as a filename literal and de-duplicates literals; exact/stem scoring chooses.
changes.why: The letter-initial token pattern returned no literal for "25.01 (18).jpeg" and latched onto the "mp4" fragment of "3631150497-preview.mp4", so 18 of 19 new assets were unreachable by filename.

changes.change: Restart-aware baseline gate plus truthful final batch counters.
changes.why: The fixed 11/869/11 gate could not resume after a genuine interruption; the replacement still blocks any drift that is not its own committed work.
AudioConfig.load refuses any config without shadow_mode; the certified v1 file and its safety gate are untouched and a separate v2 file carries the production flags.
